_comment: Tier-2 for dune::poisson_mms#0, and a CORRECTION to its wording. Measured 2026-08-06 on dune-fem 2.12.0.2, wall time 4 s. The claim says the DeprecationWarning fires when you IMPORT from dune.fem.function; it does not. A fresh subprocess that only does `from dune.fem.function import integrate` recorded ZERO warnings. The warning is emitted by the CALL, and its text is 'dune.fem.function.integrate is deprecated use dune.fem.integrate instead. New signature is (expr, gridView, order)'. The fixture asserts both halves so the old wording cannot be restored silently. It also pins the part that actually bites: the DEPRECATED function keeps the old positional order and raises TypeError "integrate() got an unexpected keyword argument 'gridView'" if you give it the new one, while dune.fem.integrate(expr, gridView=gv, order=3) works. Both returned 0.34375 for the interpolant of x^2 on a 4x4 grid, so the change is a pure rename plus a re-ordering.
